distribution.summary: Chongqing; Guangxi; Jiangsu; Jiangxi; Sichuan; Yunnan; Zhejiang; Taiwan
distribution.narrative: Smith et al. (2020) records Ambrosiodmus minor from Chongqing, Guangxi, Jiangsu, Jiangxi, Sichuan, Yunnan and Zhejiang. Lin et al. (2019) independently documents mainland field and museum records. Beaver & Liu (2010) adds the first Taiwan record from Nantou, Hui Son. Smith et al. (2022) independently reports the same reviewed China-region set, adding source support without changing the current distribution synthesis.

host_note: Lin et al. (2019) provides direct Chinese host evidence: Cinnamomum cassia, Salix sp., Toxicodendron sp. and Pinus massoniana. Beaver & Liu (2010) only describes broad polyphagy across angiosperm families, so no additional host taxon is inferred.
taxonomy_summary: The current accepted identity is Ambrosiodmus minor (Stebbing, 1907).

taxonomic_history.name: Ambrosiodmus minor
taxonomic_history.note: Current accepted name in the integrated taxonomic backbone.

nomenclature_note: Beaver & Liu (2010) notes that Ambrosiodmus minor is very similar to Ambrosiodmus lewisi and may warrant synonymy with it. This unresolved suggestion is retained as a taxonomic conflict; the two stable VSNs are not collapsed.
